body.objective: Test the smallest genuinely distinct changed-gauge mechanism left open by the minimal real Weyl-connection no-go: separate scale and internal-phase connections for a complex compensator so the Wess-Zumino radial direction and the relational clock phase need not share one Ward equation.
body.stop_condition: First import the terminal Level-3b and minimal-ladder synthesis dispositions.  If Level-3b already passes its physical causal gate, close this alternative as NOT_ACTIVATED.  Otherwise declare an action with a real Weyl scale connection W_mu, an independent compact U(1) connection A_mu and Phi=rho exp(i theta), including all gauge transformations, curvatures and allowed two-derivative parity-even terms in the minimal ansatz.  Derive the complete stationary cylinder and Berger equations, gauge-rank and reducibility complex, dressed-trace constraint, scalar/vector kinetic principal forms, raw-D and internal-clock charges.  Eliminate couplings exactly and either exhibit a nonempty healthy locus or prove the first incompatible ideal/rank/sign condition.  Any passing locus must distinguish the scale quartet from the physical phase clock and must not obtain clock evolution by leaving an anomalous scale direction physical.
body.forbid: no complexification without a real action and reality conditions; no internal U1 identified with Weyl scaling; no gauge count inferred from field names; no sampled coefficient scan; no arbitrary higher derivatives; no causal, nonlinear or quantum claim from a stationary preflight
activates: full BV and causal completion only for a certified nonempty healthy locus
body.resource_hint: FAIL-FAST CHANGED-GAUGE PREFLIGHT.  Solve Ward, stationarity, rank and health equations before building a large BV carrier.
notes: This remains inside a minimal two-connection ansatz and must not be advertised as a theorem about arbitrary metric-affine or complex gauge geometry.
